summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by Amass Brands Inc. to amend a warrant held by Streeterville Capital, LLC. The amendment reduces the exercise price to $1.50 per share for a 30-day period, after which it reverts to $16.00. The company may terminate the reduced period on two days' notice. This is a routine disclosure of warrant terms; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The filing updates a resale registration for shares listed on Nasdaq. No special-situation classification applies.
